 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 16 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Careful this week! You love to be on the grind, and it somehow gives you a kick. Now, Capricorn , while you may have decided that you want a different future, a more mindful life, old habits could feel like they are resurfacing. And this is when you take a deliberate stand. Hold your own, don't give up on your dreams and make sure you only focus courageously on what you have highlighted for yourself in the past. Communicate with vision to bring your goals to life.
 Cosmic tip: Stay ambitious and focused, but remember to also stay aligned with your new goals.
